statusLine.command: input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | jq -e 'type=="object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; g() { printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; e=$(printf '\033'); out=''; add() { if [ -n "$out" ]; then out="${out}${e}[2m · ${e}[0m$1"; else out="$1"; fi; }; model=$(g '.model.display_name // empty'); [ -n "$model" ] && add "${e}[2m${model}${e}[0m"; eff=$(g '.effort.level // empty'); if [ -n "$eff" ]; then case "$eff" in xhigh|max) c=33;; *) c=2;; esac; add "${e}[${c}m${eff}${e}[0m"; fi; pct=$(g '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$pct" ]; then n=$(printf '%.0f' "$pct" 2>/dev/null) && add "${e}[2mctx ${n}%${e}[0m"; fi; meter() { v=$(g "$1"); [ -n "$v" ] || return 0; k=$(printf '%.0f' "$v" 2>/dev/null) || return 0; if [ "$k" -ge 90 ]; then c=31; elif [ "$k" -ge 70 ]; then c=33; else c=2; fi; add "${e}[${c}m$2 ${k}%${e}[0m"; }; meter '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty' 5h; meter '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty' wk; dir=$(g '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // empty'); if [ -n "$dir" ]; then case "$dir" in "$HOME") d='~';; "$HOME"/*) d="~${dir#"$HOME"}";; *) d="$dir";; esac; add "${e}[36m${d}${e}[0m"; br=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$br" ] && br=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$br" ] && add "${e}[32m${br}${e}[0m"; fi; style=$(g '.output_style.name // empty'); [ -n "$style" ] && [ "$style" != default ] && add "${e}[2m${style}${e}[0m"; [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 0
